wiki.title: Tina McKinnor
wiki.extract: Tina Simone McKinnor (born September 30, 1964) is an American politician serving as a member of the California State Assembly for the 61st district, encompassing portions of the Westside and the South Bay regions of Los Angeles County, including Inglewood, Hawthorne, and Lawndale.
